facts: Parties: Bellhaven Analytics Ltd (Buyer), Juniper Foods Ltd (Seller); the Company is Brightwater Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 12 January 2026; Closing is scheduled for 23 April 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Calloway Marine Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $3,400,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $3,150,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $29,300,000.
